title.narrative: UNICEF’s initiatives in the Maldives have prioritized dietary diversity, prevention of micronutrient deficiencies, and promoted healthier lifestyles. Key achievements include breastfeeding support workshops, the “Minheyo Kaanaa” recipe book, health promotion through exercise such as swimming, the National Health and Nutrition Roundtable, the World Cancer Day Run, and anti-smoking campaigns.
